Container.Name: NuniFlix
Container.Overview: Movie and TV requests for Plex and Jellyfin households: browse what's streaming, request things, and Radarr/Sonarr fetch them. Includes Swipe, Movie Match, Wrapped, notifications and the Office (a little pixel-art building showing what's being watched and downloaded). Everything is set up in the first-run wizard: the one-time setup code is printed in this container's log.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The port you open NuniFlix on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Settings, accounts and the database. Back this up.
